menu_online_nopause: In co-op the world keeps running
join_title: Join by IP (LAN, or Internet with an open port)
host_note: This alpha hosts over IP/UDP. Steam invites are not available yet.
reject_version: Incompatible version: update the game to join.
reject_content: The game data does not match the server's.
reject_invalid: The server rejected the data it received.
reject_kicked: You were removed from the game.
reject_replaced: Your account joined from another session.
reject_shutdown: The host closed the game. The world has been saved.
reject_lost: Connection to the server was lost.
reject_server_fault: Internal game server error. Your last save is intact and there is an emergency copy under Load.
err_permission: You don't have permission to do that.
err_debris: There is debris here: clear it first.
err_node: Must be placed on a free, uncovered deposit.
err_rate: Too many actions in a row.
upgrade_cutter_1_d: Each cut removes twice as much debris.
upgrade_tech_assembly_d: Unlocks the Assembler and new contracts.
upgrade_tech_cryo_d: Unlocks ice extraction, coolant and cryo modules.
upgrade_tech_rail_d: Unlocks stations, rails and trains: reach the rich deposits to the northeast.
upgrade_tech_shuttle_d: Travel to Mars and unlock its industry: silicon, wafers, radiators and cargo pads.
event_hint: Abandoned branch line southeast of the base: clear the shadow scrap and move cargo by train.
err_need_stats: The contract's conditions are not met yet.
objective_o_clear: Clear 3 scrap piles with the cutter (hold left click).
objective_o_recycle: Take scrap to the Recycler ({interact}) and produce 8 recovered material.
objective_o_extractor: Clear the ice crust from an ore deposit and place an Extractor ({tool_build}).
objective_o_smelter: Build a Smelter near the extractor.
objective_o_link: With the linker ({tool_link}), connect extractor → smelter → depot or terminal.
objective_o_sell: Sell goods at the Export terminal until you earn 50 credits.
objective_o_parts: Build an Assembler and produce 8 machine parts.
objective_o_rail_tech: Buy the Railway licence ({tech}). The rich deposits to the northeast yield 2.5 times more.
objective_o_station: Build two stations: one by the factory and one by the rich deposits.
objective_o_train: Join the stations with rails ({tool_rail}), create a train in their panel ({interact_panel}) and deliver 40 units by train.
objective_o_mars: Travel to Mars from the Shuttle terminal ({interact}).
objective_o_silicon: Clear a Martian deposit and place a Silicon extractor ({tool_build}).
objective_o_wafer: Refine 15 wafers. On Mars, whatever generates heat runs slower without cooling.
objective_o_radiator: Build a Radiator: check the Heat line at the top left.
objective_o_pad: Build a Cargo pad on each planet, set one to SEND and ship cargo.
objective_o_nav: Bring cryo modules from Pluto and make 3 Navigation cores.
objective_done: Ninth Planet Project completed! Pluto is an industrial world again. Keep optimizing your factory.
pad_mode_send: Mode: SENDS its contents to the other planet
pad_mode_receive: Mode: RECEIVES cargo from the other planet
prompt_link_to: [Left click] Choose the destination   [Right click] Cancel
prompt_remove: [Left click] Dismantle (cost and contents go to the depot)   [Right click] Cancel
prompt_interact: [{interact}] Open   [{interact_insert}] Deposit all   [{interact_take}] Collect all   [{interact_panel}] Panel
prompt_rail_from: [Left click] Rail start   [{rotate}] Straight/curve   [Right click] Cancel
prompt_rail_to: [Left click] Place section   [{rotate}] Straight/curve   [Right click] Cancel
err_rail_shape: That section isn't possible: straights at 0°, 45° or 90°, curves equal on both axes.
err_rail_occupied: A train is using that track.
err_rail_blocked: The route crosses a machine or debris.
err_same_planet: You are already on that planet.
inv_empty: Your backpack is empty. Cut scrap or ice with the multitool.
inv_no_machine: Move close to a depot or a machine to transfer materials.
inv_detail_hint: Hover over an item to see its details
inv_refused: This machine does not accept this material or is full.
inv_help_items: Click: whole stack   ·   Shift+click: half   ·   Ctrl+click: one unit   ·   Right click: choose amount   ·   Drag: move   ·   Keyboard: arrows and Enter, also with Shift or Ctrl   ·   Hovering equipment, a number pins it to that slot
inv_help_catalog: Click: choose and place   ·   Right click: pin to the first free slot   ·   While hovering, a number pins to that slot   ·   Drag to the bar
inv_catalog_hint: Hover over a building to see what is missing
inv_catalog_pin: Pin it to the bar by dragging, with right click or with a number.
hotbar_tip: Click: use   ·   Right click: clear   ·   Drag: move
hotbar_empty_tip: Drag a tool or building here
hotbar_locked: You have not unlocked this building yet
hotbar_full: The hotbar is full: drop onto a slot to replace it
tool_cutter_d: Cuts scrap, ice and rock. Hold left click close to the target.
tool_link_d: Connects two machines to carry material.
tool_remove_d: Removes machines and rails; cost and contents return to the depot.
tool_rail_d: Lays rails between stations for trains.
item_scrap_d: Metal remains from the planet. The Recycler turns them into recovered material.
item_recovered_d: Clean metal, the base of your first buildings.
item_ore_d: Raw ore from deposits. Smelts into ingots.
item_ingot_d: Refined metal for machines and contracts.
item_ice_d: Nitrogen and water ice. Raw material for coolant.
item_coolant_d: Keeps heat in check and feeds the cryogenic chain.
item_nav_core_d: Key piece of the Ninth Planet Project.
